702227.t: From ἀπο- (apo-, “off”) + ὁρίζω (horĭ́zō, “separate”), from ὅρος (hóros, “boundary”) + -ίζω (-ízō, denominative verb suffix).

702211.t: From ἀφ- (aph-, “apo-, away from”) + ἵημι (híēmi, “to send, throw”).

702255.t: Loaned from a non-Indo-European source, possibly Semitic (compare Aramaic עקיק). The river Ἀχάτης in Sicily is probably named after the mineral.

702202.t: From ἅπτω (háptō, “to kindle, set fire; to touch; to fasten”) + -ή (-ḗ).

702215.t: Related to ἐξαίφνης (exaíphnēs), αἴφνης (aíphnēs, “suddenly”), ἐξαπίνης (exăpínēs, “id”), of uncertain origin.

702205.t: ἀ- (a-) + φθαρσία (phtharsía), equivalent to ἄφθαρτος (áphthartos, “indestructible, immortal, eternal”) + -ία (-íā).

702231.t: From ἀ- (a-, “a-, un-”) + φορολογέω (phorologéō, “to levy tribute from”) + -τος (-tos).
